name: Blueberry Oat Smoothie
steps: Soak oats in 180 ml milk for 10 minutes until softened; rinse fresh blueberries and check them for stems.
Blend soaked oats and their milk with yogurt and sliced banana until the oats are finely broken down.
Add blueberries, remaining 180 ml milk, honey and cinnamon; blend until smooth and thick, scraping down the blender once.
Divide into four glasses and serve at once before the oats continue to thicken the drink.
tips: For a smooth texture, use rolled oats rather than coarse steel-cut oats.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
